clean_tool_results.description: Allows the model to clean redundant tool results.
rules: Use <CLEAN_TOOL_RESULTS> T1, T2, T3 </CLEAN_TOOL_RESULTS> to remove one or more existing TOOL_RESULT entries. Put exact T<number> tool_id values from the current TOOLS_RESULTS block inside the paired tags, separated by commas. Every listed ID is validated before cleanup; if any ID is invalid or missing, nothing is removed. Use an empty <CLEAN_TOOL_RESULTS></CLEAN_TOOL_RESULTS> block only when ALL tool results must be deleted, including legacy ID-less results.
